title: agenda_left_pane — instance contract
description: Validation schema for a single `use` instance of the agenda_left_pane symbol. The symbol renders a section opener with a wide reverse-out left pane, a thin accent stripe, and a pre-numbered list (1.–7.) of agenda items in the right field. Numerals are baked into the symbol; the caller supplies only the item bodies.

type.description: FrameGraph object type — must be 'use' for symbol instantiation.

box.description: [x, y, w, h] of the instance on the slide. Use [0, 0, 960, 540] for a full-canvas section opener.

section_label.description: Reverse-out title rendered inside the left pane (e.g. 'Summary', 'Agenda', 'Contents').

page_number.description: Footer numeral (e.g. '2' or '02'). Optional — pass an empty string to suppress.

left_pane_color.description: Wide left-block fill (deep navy by default).

accent_color.description: Vertical stripe color on the seam between the panes.

params.description: Per-instance rect fills. Text colors are NOT instance params — they come from the deck-level text styles listed under `required_text_styles`.

agenda_item.description: One line of the numbered list. Empty string leaves the row blank.

oneOf.description: Named color token resolved from deck.tokens.colors.

x-required-text-styles.description: Deck-level text styles the template depends on. The deck MUST declare each name under `deck.tokens.text_styles` with the documented role.
x-required-text-styles.agenda_section_label: Reverse-out title (light on dark) for the left pane.
x-required-text-styles.agenda_item_num: Numerals '1.' '2.' … rendered next to each agenda item.
x-required-text-styles.agenda_item: Numbered list body text in the right field.
